research_question: Can a frozen Candidate-v2 retrieval backend be paired with an independent proposition-level answerability verifier that materially reduces no-evidence false retrieval while preserving answerable retrieval quality?

retrieval_backend.verifier_input: ordered top-k memory IDs and memory contents only

query_parser.rule: Every explicit query requirement is mandatory unless the query marks it optional or alternative.

evidence_parser.rule: A retrieved memory may create zero or more evidence propositions; topic overlap alone creates no support edge.

subject_matching.rule: A proposition supports a requirement only when the requirement subject and proposition subject are identical after deterministic normalization/alias resolution. Unresolved multi-entity ownership is not a match.

relation_matching.rule: Predicate concepts are field-granular; adjacent attributes such as phone/email, budget/balance, number/code/PIN are distinct unless an explicit preregistered alias maps them.

value_matching.rule: A support edge requires an asserted object/value compatible with the requirement. Query wording, relation words, discourse markers, uncertainty markers, and pure lexical overlap are not values.

temporal_rules.rule: Support must satisfy the query reference time or interval. Current/latest queries reject stale-only evidence. Before/after/as-of semantics require ordered temporal compatibility. Superseded evidence cannot support a current requirement unless the query explicitly asks for the historical state.

contradiction_rules.rule: Conflicting supported values for the same subject/predicate/temporal requirement produce CONTRADICTED or AMBIGUOUS unless an explicit update/supersession relation resolves the conflict.

completeness_rules.rule: Every mandatory atomic requirement must have at least one conflict-free support path. Multi-memory composition is allowed. Any uncovered mandatory requirement causes INSUFFICIENT.

query_echo_guard.rule: After removing query-derived lexical cues and predicate boilerplate from a memory proposition, answer-bearing object/value content must remain. Exact or near query echoes with no answer-bearing residue do not create support.

abstention_rules.SUPPORTED: All mandatory requirements have conflict-free, temporally valid support paths.
abstention_rules.INSUFFICIENT: One or more mandatory requirements lack support, required subject/predicate/value/temporal state is unresolved, or parsing fails closed.
abstention_rules.CONTRADICTED: At least one mandatory requirement has unresolved conflicting values/polarities.
abstention_rules.AMBIGUOUS: Evidence can support multiple unresolved subject/value interpretations without a unique support path.
abstention_rules.ranking_output: Return frozen candidate-v2 ranking only for SUPPORTED; otherwise return [].

allowed_information: adversarial-v6 historical diagnostics and failure-family taxonomy
Candidate-v2/v3/v4 source for architecture comparison only
fresh Candidate-v5 development data generated after this preregistration
forbidden_information: future protected validation labels before Candidate-v5 freeze
future adversarial-v7 results before Candidate-v5 freeze and v7 preregistration
using adversarial-v6 as Candidate-v5 clean validation or confirmatory selection

improvement_vs_candidate_v2.metric: absolute reduction in no-evidence false-retrieval rate
improvement_vs_candidate_v2.note: If an already-frozen repository protocol defines this metric more precisely, that frozen definition controls; it may not be weakened post-result.

local_model_policy.reason: First Candidate-v5 identity is preregistered as deterministic-only for reproducibility. Introducing a local model would change method identity and requires a new candidate unless explicitly preregistered before implementation.
